items.action: None, unless a loading button with an `icon` must keep hiding its label behind a centred spinner: bind `loadingMode="replace"` on that button.
items.appliesWhen: A `ds-button` that sets both `icon` and `loading`. A button without `icon` renders as before, and `ds-icon-button` has no loading state.
items.verify: A loading `ds-button` with an `icon` shows its label with a spinner in the icon's place, unless it binds `loadingMode="replace"`.

items.action: None, unless a test or a selector finds the date input by the `textbox` role: query the `combobox` role instead.
items.appliesWhen: A test, a selector or a template that targets the text input of a `ds-date-picker` by role.
items.verify: The `ds-date-picker` text input reports `role="combobox"` and still parses a typed date.

items.action: None, unless a layout relied on the gap between menu rows (the default was `var(--space-0-5)`, now `0px`): set `--ds-menu-gap: var(--space-0-5)` on that menu.
items.appliesWhen: A `ds-menu` that does not set `--ds-menu-gap`. A menu that sets it keeps its value, and the strip between rows where the pointer hovers no row.
items.verify: A `ds-menu` without `--ds-menu-gap` renders its rows touching, and one that sets `--ds-menu-gap: var(--space-0-5)` shows the gap between rows again.

informational.text: New `[dsPopoverTrigger]` directive (`DsPopoverTrigger`, exported with `PopoverComponent`) opens a `ds-popover` from a button and sets `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` on its inner `<button>`.
informational.verify: A `ds-icon-button` with `[dsPopoverTrigger]` around a `ds-menu` popover: Enter opens the menu, the inner button reads aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded="true", and Escape closes it and returns focus to the button.

informational.text: Now in a single `ds-time-picker` picks the current time and closes the panel; a range panel stays open until Done. A single panel used to stay open after Now.
informational.verify: Open a single `ds-time-picker` and press Now: the current time is set and the panel closes. In a range picker the panel stays open after Now.

informational.text: A looping hour or minute column of `ds-time-picker` marks only the copy of the selected value nearest the column's centre with `is-selected`, so a test that counts `.is-selected` cells inside its internal `ds-time-columns` element sees fewer than before.
informational.verify: Scroll a minute column with a 15-minute step and `loop="always"`: one cell carries `is-selected` at a time.

informational.text: The trigger `<button>` of `ds-time-picker` holds its shown time in an inner `<span>` beside hidden `.time-value-sizer` spans (`aria-hidden="true"`) that reserve its width, so the text content of the trigger also contains their text.
informational.verify: A `ds-time-picker` set to 09:30 shows `09:30` and keeps the same width when cleared; a query by role and accessible name still finds the trigger.

informational.text: A resizable `ds-table` column draws its resize handle as a thin line in `--border-default` at rest; before, the line was transparent until hover, drag or keyboard focus.
informational.verify: Open a `ds-table` with `dsTableResize` on a pointer device: every resizable header cell shows a thin line at its right edge before the pointer reaches it.

informational.text: A keyboard-focused column resize handle of a `ds-table` draws the standard focus ring; before, it widened its line to `--border-width-strong` and drew no outline outside forced-colors mode.
informational.verify: Tab to a column separator of a `ds-table` with `dsTableResize`: the focus ring shows around the handle.

informational.text: The column resize separators of a `ds-table` with `dsTableResize` carry `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin` and `aria-valuemax` whenever the column's width is known; before, only the focused separator carried them, so a test that reads or counts them now sees them on every separator.
informational.verify: Query the separators of a `ds-table` with `dsTableResize` before focusing any: each has the three attributes.

informational.text: In the typed mask of `ds-date-picker`, a separator takes the placeholder colour until the part before it holds all its digits; before, separators always took the value colour.
informational.verify: Open an empty `ds-date-picker` with a typed mask and type `12`: the first slash reads in the value colour and the second in the placeholder colour.

informational.text: A `ds-time-picker` hour or minute column that does not loop (`loop="never"`, or `'auto'` where the column does not overflow) scrolls at the browser's wheel speed and snaps to a cell; before, every hour and minute column stepped by whole rows per wheel notch, looping or not.
informational.verify: Turn the wheel over a minute column with `loop="never"`: it scrolls as far as a native list and settles on a cell.

informational.text: A `ds-menu-item` that is the first or last child of its parent takes the menu's inner radius on its outer corners, so its focus ring follows the rounded corners of the menu; before, those rows were square and the menu clipped them.
informational.verify: Open a `ds-menu` and focus its first item with the keyboard: the ring follows the rounded top corners and is not cut off.

informational.text: `ds-chart`, `ds-column-chart`, `ds-line-chart` and `ds-waterfall-chart` measure the width of their axis labels again once the page's web fonts have loaded; before, they measured when they rendered and when a label's text changed.
informational.verify: Open a page whose web font arrives after a chart: the value-axis labels are not clipped and the gutter matches their width.
